title: MXZ Gaming PC with RTX 4070: A Ready-to-Play Ryzen 5 Desktop
summary: Review the MXZ gaming PC with Ryzen 5 7500F, RTX 4070, 16GB DDR5, 1TB NVMe storage, Wi-Fi, and Windows 11 Pro.
body_markdown:
Looking for a gaming desktop that is ready to set up out of the box? The MXZ High Performance Gaming PC brings together an AMD Ryzen 5 7500F processor, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 graphics, 16GB of DDR5 memory, and a 1TB NVMe SSD. Windows 11 Pro is included, so this prebuilt system is designed to get you gaming without the extra work of choosing compatible parts or assembling a PC.


## Contenders Overview


For shoppers who want a complete gaming desktop, the MXZ configuration offers a straightforward path to purchase. The system includes a B650 motherboard, a 750W 80+ power supply, built-in Wi-Fi, a windowed side panel, and multiple RGB fans.


A DIY desktop build can provide more control over component brands and models, but it also means researching compatibility, installing the operating system, and completing the assembly yourself. The MXZ system is a better fit for buyers who would rather have those steps handled before the PC arrives.


## Side-by-Side Comparison


When comparing a prebuilt gaming PC with a separate DIY build, these are the specifications that matter most for getting started, playing games, managing storage, and planning future upgrades.


- **Processor:** The MXZ PC uses an AMD Ryzen 5 7500F with 6 cores, 12 threads, and a 3.7GHz to 5.3GHz clock range.
- **Graphics:** An NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 is included, giving the system dedicated graphics instead of relying on integrated graphics.
- **Memory:** The desktop comes with 16GB of DDR5-6000 memory.
- **Storage:** A 1TB NVMe SSD serves as the primary storage drive.
- **Platform:** The B650 motherboard supports the Ryzen-based configuration, and Windows 11 Pro comes included.
- **Power and connectivity:** The listed configuration includes a 750W 80+ power supply and built-in Wi-Fi.

The combination of the Ryzen 5 7500F and RTX 4070 gives this MXZ desktop a focused gaming profile. Its six-core, 12-thread processor is specified for boost clocks up to 5.3GHz, while the dedicated RTX 4070 takes care of graphics workloads. With 16GB of DDR5-6000 memory, the system also has a balanced starting point for current gaming and everyday multitasking.


The 1TB NVMe SSD provides solid-state storage for the system and games, offering a faster foundation than a traditional hard drive.
